Development assistance is disclosed in the report. Sources: report/main.tex and docs/team/MID1_TEAM_GUIDE.md.

slides.speaker_notes: Soban, 45 seconds. Trace emit and verify. The sequence/activity models include the click, alternative branches and fallback failure.

slides.title: Live demonstration
slides.speaker_notes: Shared, 240 seconds: Rafay opens 20; Soban Decision 40; Ahmed Evidence 40; Rafay Risk 60; Soban Explanation 80. Both profile extremes abstain on weak real evidence; show the changing score/threshold without claiming fabricated prediction quality.

slides.title: Calibration correction and abstention
slides.speaker_notes: Soban, 55 seconds. Explain the isotonic global bounds, calibration-only temperature fit and why near-uniform confidence requires abstention. Do not describe this as useful forecasting.

slides.title: Temporal leakage experiment
slides.speaker_notes: Ahmed, 100 seconds. Explain actual label availability, how the canary fires, and why a weak no-purge/lag variation is not proof that every leakage mechanism is absent. State the FNSPID precision/coverage reason for the timestamped source.

slides.title: Sentiment and teacher studies
slides.speaker_notes: Rafay, 100 seconds. FinBERT still scores news. CryptoBERT/Cardiff are social candidates. Sanity probes are separate authored diagnostics, not benchmark accuracy. Teacher/student method is disclosed once in the report.
